body:
The validation-only Transport candidate is rejected: **16/22 original native conditions pass**. The single fixed A1/B1/B2/A2 trial and independent raw-XML recomputation agree.

| Complete-call gain | Legacy | Modern |
| --- | ---: | ---: |
| Forward | +18.0513% | +39.5725% |
| Reverse | +1.2940% | -7.8294% |

Both reverse whole-call gates miss the original +5% minimum. Four reverse-modern inclusive stage gates also miss -5%: Dopri rows 12 -11.7880%, Dopri rows 24 -5.5842%, Endpoint rows 12 -12.3039%, Endpoint rows 24 -8.4738%. Both Create-and-all-11-API windows pass (+90.1711%, +0.1135%). These unchanged Endpoint/Dopri timings establish no causal diagnosis.

The first original control 8 and all four slots passed original correctness assertions, equal 32 complete-buffer readback records, 51 ordered markers and 54 actual module joins per case, same-child SDK/AMD identity and guarded terminal ownership. Only the native Transport payload changed; the original five-word scratch, numerical helpers, other 39 arrays/seven tables/two owners and c948 observer 27 test bodies/1492 ordered assertions stayed exact. No thresholds, settings, pooling, subtraction, warmup or retry changed. Remaining 7 controls were not run; no production adoption.

[Immutable source, compiler/producer proof, exact artifact ZIP and all raw results](https://github.com/sunyaisblank/Sirius/tree/545582306752214df297bc588ccc856c7647e313/attestations/qualification/5b2df58b/native-transport-validation-rejected), tag `evidence/native-transport-validation-rejected-5b2df58b`. Private Windows producer [ac6559d7](https://github.com/sunyaisblank/Sirius/commit/ac6559d7e2910b4a8f11fedadc320f3e4d1bf8f4), [sole successful build](https://github.com/sunyaisblank/Sirius/actions/runs/39109116124); all 538 canonical source blobs/modes equal 5b2. Canonical development remains 5b2; main and draft PR #62 remain unmerged. No full scientific, original-frame, Mandatory or release qualification follows from this valid rejection.
